fato_historico: 1936: The last thylacine, a carnivorous marsupial, dies alone in its cage at the Hobart Zoo in Tasmania.
energia_do_dia: Today, your radiant spirit may feel particularly sensitive to the stories of the past. Just as a forgotten species once faded from view, consider how the legacy of your own individuality impacts those around you. It is a good time to cherish your connections and ensure your inner fire burns with compassion and lasting purpose.
frase_do_dia: Your unique light leaves a footprint that echoes through the corridors of time.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the wisdom of experience.
conselho: Practice radical kindness and honor the precious uniqueness of every living soul today.
